description.value:
Sun-Yolk Eye is a fleck of it. This is a vein of it.

Gift — Resistance 5 to fire, and once per day your blood ignites at a wound: a creature damaging you with a melee attack takes 2d6 fire. Tithe — You cannot be put out. Fire on you burns until its fuel is gone, and cold- or water-based healing does not work on you at all.

cinderfall.incomplete: The reactive 2d6 fire damage to a melee attacker (once per day) and the 'cold- or water-based healing does not work on you at all' restriction both have no rule-element equivalent: the first targets another creature's HP from a self-held item (the same gap as Grave-Quiet/Toxic-Sweat), and the second needs a selector for 'healing received, but only from a specific source type,' which doesn't exist -- the closest real hook, healing-received (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/bestiary-effects/effect-void-tendrils.json), only reduces the amount, it can't fully block by source.
